properties.name: Nordvik Paper Mill
properties.description: A disused paper mill with loading bays, rusted conveyors, and a wide service yard.
comments: The west dock is still mentioned in forum notes as the easiest visual confirmation point.
Several posts reference broken windows on the north side and a visible rail spur behind the building.

properties.name: St. Brigid's Hospital
properties.description: A former county hospital with an empty ward block, service tunnels, and an abandoned courtyard.
comments: Posts mention the old ambulance entrance and the intact tiled corridor to the east wing.
A later reply confirms the site is fenced but still visible from the public road.

properties.name: Black Pine Bunker
properties.description: A shallow concrete bunker complex hidden in forest cover with multiple sealed entrances.
comments: One comment points to the tree line north of the gravel road as the clearest clue.
Another confirms the ventilation stacks and a collapsed hatch near the service path.

properties.name: Northpoint Military Depot
properties.description: A former military storage depot with long warehouse rows and a security perimeter that still remains partly intact.
comments: The thread says the depot sits beyond the old training road and close to the rail branch.
A second post confirms the front gate is the most recognizable landmark from the main road.

properties.name: Raven Pass Tunnel
properties.description: A maintenance tunnel under the hillside with drainage channels and a service hatch nearby.
comments: Forum replies repeatedly mention the curved retaining wall at the east entrance.
A final comment confirms the tunnel mouth is visible below the footpath bridge.

properties.name: Iron Harbor Warehouse
properties.description: A waterfront storage block with broken loading doors, weathered signage, and a fenced truck bay.
comments: One comment says the warehouse is directly across from the dry dock crane.
Another confirms the best reference is the row of loading doors facing the quay.
